
No producing handler gains a hardcoded notifier; every outbound consequence is an offset-tracked subscriber (WL-REQ-107). Orchestrated work sends no email or chat message; the first human-facing consequence is the per-user Morning Brief in the cockpit, derived from lifecycle events, with an explicit **Reviewed through now** cursor (WL-REQ-346).

A Google Chat space per project, kept in step with its Crew, is designed, not built.
